{{short description|Indian states and union territories by NSDP (Net state domestic product) per capita}}
{{About|NSDP per capita|GDP|List of Indian states and union territories by GDP}}
{{Update|part=the 2024-25 year data|date=March 2026}}
{{Use Indian English|date=October 2015}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2022}}
{{Lists of states and territories of India}}

This is a list of Indian states and union territories by their per capita net state domestic product (NSDP). NSDP is the state counterpart to a country's [[net domestic product]] (NDP), which equals the [[gross domestic product]] (GDP) minus depreciation on capital goods.<ref>{{cite book |first1=Rudiger |last1=Dornbusch |authorlink=Rudi Dornbusch |first2=Stanley |last2=Fischer |authorlink2=Stanley Fischer |first3=Richard |last3=Startz |title=Macroeconomics |location=New York |publisher=McGraw-Hill Irwin |year=2004 |isbn=0-07-282340-2 |pages=22–23 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=J-XtAAAAMAAJ&pg=PA23 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bea.gov/help/glossary/net-domestic-product-ndp|title=Net domestic product (NDP)|publisher=U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA)|access-date=23 June 2019}}</ref>
